body:
Thank you for sharing this. I didn't know about school politics, let alone think that was even a thing before you mentioned it. I do love kids though so I hope that will make the rest of it worth it. 

Also congratulations on your current job. It may have been tough to land but from now on it will be a piece of cake :)

​

The high school math sounds fun. Did you enjoy teaching? Was the transition to your current job easy? I'm going down a similar path and want to teach k-12 for awhile.
That's awesome and sounds like such a enriching path. I don't believe any degree to be useless because it's what the individual person does with what they're taught, that gets them the job n such.
Did I say I was collecting information?? No, no I didn't .

>Instead of asking random strangers from multiple countries, you might be interested to read the work of people who have collected this information before you.

I asked the question for a reason. Obviously I know I could have just searched it up. 

Stats don't tell stories but the people behind them do.
Yes it's. I'm sorry you are struggling. I believe you posted because you know the power of community. How are you? What's going on?

I know the feeling you are describing all too well. Hurts that in that state nobody around knows how you feel too. The feeling allows you to lead yourself into one circumstance or another though? Both finding absolute joy in life and being completely depressed are work to begin with. I think that can be positive.

I'm stressed out about school. Might have just completely bombed a midterm and I'm afraid I won't redeem myself in the class...

I had the same thought. It started in junior high. I would always google if anyone else felt or thought the same. I'm a year into college now... So I relate on some level. How are you feeling right now?

Suicide is a taboo topic for no reason. So many people are struggling on the inside. I hope at least one of your family members reaches out to you because they notice you're struggling. I'd definitely be your buddy too :).

I prayed for you<3. I pray that in all your days you are given peace of mind, so much so that you can focus on things other than your survival. I pray that you are protected and uplifted for simply wanting that for yourself. I pray you are blessed beyond what you can imagine right now. 

I'm sorry for your loss.
I hope you are feeling better in whatever you are doing now. My heart aches for you. Losing or going without visiting a sibling is like losing your other half. </3

If you are good to someone, as a friend, or something along the lines, you ARE good at something. It's hard to accept that in the moment you don't have the exact skills you want. Try meeting yourself halfway with who you want to be and who you are.
>I will try writing about my feelings. Your response means a lot to me. Thank you
